utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Okay, um, can everyone hear me? Ivan, you're on mute I think- no, sorry, you're fine.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: Yeah, I'm here.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: Did anyone get the close calendar from Stefan? I never-

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: He sent it Thursday, I think. Or was that the old one, the one with the, uh, the holiday dates wrong?

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: The old one. Great.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: I think maybe I can forward the updated one after this. Um, it's, it should be in my inbox somewhere.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Please do. Last month I was working off a version that had the wrong cutoff and it was a mess.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: That was the thing with the accruals, right? Where Tomasz had to redo the whole - I mean he had already posted half of it and-

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: Pavel, we can do accruals later.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Right, right. Sorry.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: So, um, I wanted to, I think maybe we should spend, uh, most of today on the invoice approval thing. Because, well, Emeka asked me twice this week where we are.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Where we are is nowhere, honestly. Invoices still go around by email.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: And half of them get stuck in somebody's- sorry, go ahead.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: No, you're right. Stuck in somebody's inbox.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Right. So I think we only know about one real option so far, which is, well, there's the thing in the ERP, and-

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Oh, is that the one Marisol showed us at the, the demo? With the grey dashboard?

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: I don't, I'm not sure it was Marisol. Maybe Sanne.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: It was Marisol. She had the, the green jacket on. Anyway.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: It was Sanne, I think.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Okay, doesn't matter. Um. Camila, you had, you looked at it, didn't you?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: I did. Okay, so, I'll just say it. We should use the approval module that comes with the ERP we already have.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: Wait, the bundled one? I thought that was extra.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: It's priced, yeah, eleven thousand a year. But hold on, that's the part-

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: Eleven thousand is not nothing.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: It's not, but let me finish. We're already licensed for the platform, so there's no new vendor, no new contract, nothing to onboard.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Mm. Um, go on.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: And configuring it is about two weeks, they said. Two weeks of setup. There's no data migration, because the vendors and the GL codes are already sitting in there.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Two weeks, that sounds, I mean, that sounds optimistic. When we did the expense thing it was, what, six?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: That was a different thing, that moved data from three places. This doesn't move anything.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: Okay but what do we actually get out of it? Like, in numbers.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Right, so I pulled the timestamps from last quarter. Median time from invoice received to approved is nine days right now. With routing in the module it should land around three.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: Nine days? Median? Not the average?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Median. The average is worse, there's a long tail of stuff stuck over a month.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: Is that, um, nine days including the ones that go to the regional offices?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Yes, all of it.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: Okay. That's, yeah. That's a lot.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: It's a lot. I think maybe, um, it also affects the early-pay discounts, doesn't it?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: It does, we've been missing a couple of those.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Speaking of discounts, did you see what happened with the freight vendor? They sent a statement with, like, the same invoice listed twice and-

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: Is that this topic?

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: No, no. Not really. It's just funny. They had it twice and one had a different PO number.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Pavel, can you, um, maybe send that to Umar? He handles the freight stuff.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll forward it today.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: Okay. Back to- can I push on the price a bit?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Go ahead, that's fair.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: Eleven thousand a year, every year. If we get a better tool in six months we're, we're stuck paying that?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: It's annual. We could stop renewing. And what's the alternative, nothing? Because right now the cost is people chasing approvals by hand.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: I'm not saying nothing. I'm saying, did anyone look-

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Um, Ravi, I think nobody has brought another one to me. Has someone?

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: No. Not yet. I just don't love picking the first thing we see.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: It's also the one with the least risk, though. Honestly I'd argue it's the boring choice and that's why it works.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: Can I ask about permissions?

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Please, yes.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: Um, so the, the approval limits. Who sets those? Because right now it's kind of, it lives in Stefan's head.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: They'd be set up in the config. Tiers by amount, and by cost center. We'd need to write them down first, which we should do anyway.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: Okay. That's good. That, that would help me.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Oh, that reminds me, the audit people wanted the thresholds written down too. Last year they asked and we sort of, we showed them an email from, from like twenty-nineteen.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: Not great.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Not great, no.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: So that, that's another reason, I think. Um.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Right. It gives us a paper trail without extra work.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: Fine, but two weeks of whose time? Because month-end is coming.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Mostly mine and the ERP admin's. Maybe a few hours from Pavel for the vendor master cleanup.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: A few hours I can do. If it's, you know, not the week of the close.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Yeah, okay. Um. Does anyone, does anybody have a real objection? Like something that would stop us?

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: Not a stop. I'd want the renewal date in writing, so we know when we can walk.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: I'll ask for it. I'll put it in the order form request.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: Then I'm okay.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: I'm okay with it too. I mean, yes.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Okay. Good. Pavel, could you get the configuration work on the calendar, with the ERP admin, for maybe the first week after the close? Um, sorry, I mean, something like that.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Sure. I'll check what Sanne's free, uh, I mean the admin's free, and send invites tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Send me the draft so I can block the days.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Will do.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Thank you. Um, and I'll tell Emeka we have a plan, he'll be glad.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: Tell him the nine days number. He likes numbers.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: I will. Okay, other things. Did anybody hear about the team lunch?

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Is that the Thursday one? Because I have the thing with, uh, the- no, sorry, I have a thing Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Maybe Friday then. Ivan, does Friday work?

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: Friday's fine.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: Friday's good for me, I'm in anyway.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: I can do Friday if it's before one. I've got a call.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Okay, I think maybe noon. I'll ask the place if they have a table for five.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Tomasz might want to come too, he was asking.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Then six. Okay, I'll, um, I'll check. Right, I think that's it. I have to jump to another call.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: Yep, go.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Thanks, everyone.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Okay, um, I think we're all here. How was everyone's week, did the lunch place work out?

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: The lunch was great. Did you see the dessert they brought out? The one with the burnt sugar on top, my grandmother used to make something like that, she'd-

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: It was fine. Is Tomasz joining today?

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: No, he's on audit prep with Stefan this morning.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Which reminds me, is the March close calendar final?

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: I think maybe it is. Stefan said he'd send the final one Monday.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: I have his draft. Cutoff is the fourth, I believe.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: The fourth, okay. Last time I had the wrong date and it still bugs me.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: Quick thing before I forget. Who's covering the bank rec Friday?

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: I can. I'm in all day.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: Great, thanks.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Oh, speaking of the bank, did anyone see the new login page? They moved the whole token thing to a different button and I spent ten minutes-

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Pavel, um, maybe we can come back to that.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Right, sorry. Later.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: So, I had a call yesterday that I should tell you about. It's about the invoice approval thing.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: The ERP module?

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Yes. I phoned the account rep to ask about the order form. The renewal date, mostly.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: Did he send it?

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: He did, that's fine. But then he mentioned something I really didn't expect, and he said it like it was old news.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: Uh oh.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: The module we picked, the bundled one, they stop supporting it at the end of this year. After December there are no security patches for it, none.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Wait, none? For something that would be handling payment approvals?

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: That's, yeah. That's not good.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: No. And I don't, um, I don't think we can sign for it knowing that. So I think maybe we need to open the question again and look at what else is out there.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: Fair. Nobody can argue with that.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Okay, I'll be the annoying one. Is it really a problem? A year of use is a year of use. We could just replace it later.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Um, maybe. But we'd be doing the setup twice. Two weeks of config, then again.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: True. I'm only asking.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: And the auditors. They'd ask about unpatched stuff straight away.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: They would. Okay, fine, I withdraw that.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: So what are we looking at? The other one, the, the one with the capture feature?

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Yes, that one. The standalone one. I think it was twenty-six thousand a year, from the quote.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: Twenty-six. Versus eleven. That's, that's more than double.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Not even a little bit double. It's a lot more than double. Sorry, I mean, it's a lot.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: It is. Um, I'm not saying that's nothing.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: Is it a new vendor then? New contract and all that?

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Yes. Legal would need to look at it.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: How long does legal take on a thing like that?

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: I think maybe two or three weeks, if nothing weird is in it. I can ask Marisol.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Marisol's good with these. She was fast on the freight one.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Okay, so, can I say something about why that one makes sense? Because I looked at it again last night.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Please, yes.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: So the thing is, it's got its own support team. If something breaks, it's their problem, not some ticket with the ERP people that sits for a month.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: Mm.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: And it pulls in our vendor list and account codes straight from the ERP, so no retyping that stuff, no master cleanup.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: That's a big one, honestly.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: And the real thing, the invoices. We get something like fourteen hundred a month, right? Roughly seventy percent of those are PDFs sitting in an email.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: That sounds about right. Most of mine are.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: The capture reads those. So nobody is keying them in. When I did the math on the typing time it comes to about sixty hours a month. Maybe a bit over.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: Sixty hours a month. That's like, more than a person's week.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: A week and a half, probably.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Does it read badly scanned ones? Because we get some of those from the regional offices.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Those would still need someone, I'd think. It's the clean PDFs that work. That's the seventy.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Okay. That's still most of it.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: Who checks the reads? Like, when it gets an amount wrong?

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: There's a review screen, I think. Somebody confirms before it goes to approval.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: Okay. Good, I just wondered.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: And the approval limits would work the same?

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: I believe so, tiers by amount. I'd want to see it again to be sure.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Um, we can ask for a second demo. That's fine.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: I want to see that before we sign anything. The scanned ones especially.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Yes, that's reasonable.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: Hey, Pavel, do you remember who ran the first demo? Last time you said it was Marisol and then it was Sanne.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: It was Sanne. Okay, I admit it was Sanne.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: Told you.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: You did. In my head she's always in the green jacket, though.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Okay, let's, um. Let me think about the whole thing for a second.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: Take your time.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: The old one has no patches after December. The other one costs more but saves a lot of typing, and it has someone to call. So, the standalone accounts payable automation tool is what we're adopting. I'll tell Emeka today, and I'll ask Marisol to start on the contract.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Okay. I'll send you the questions I have for the second demo.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: And the budget? Eleven was already approved, the other fifteen is-

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: I'll take that to Emeka as well. He'll want it in writing.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: Yeah, he will.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: Do we tell the ERP rep anything?

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Um, not yet. I think maybe after the contract. I don't want to burn the renewal date before we know.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: Makes sense.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Pavel, can you pull the invoice counts by month for Emeka? He'll ask.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Sure. I can have it by Wednesday. Probably Tuesday, if the report doesn't hang again.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Wednesday's fine.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Wait, I do have one more thing about that report, there's a filter that sorts by the posting date and not the received date, which-

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: We've been through this.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Fine. I'll just fix it.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Okay. Other things. Did the intern thing get sorted, the desk?

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: They put her near the window, I think. By Sanne.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Does she have a login yet?

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: Not yet. I asked Tomasz, he said Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Thursday, okay.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Um, anyone else have anything?

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: The expense policy. Someone said the meal limit changed.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Oh. I think maybe it went up, but I haven't seen the memo.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: I'll look for it.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: I heard fifty-five. Per day. Or was that per trip?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: I'd wait for the memo.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Yes. Let's wait for that. Okay, I need to go, I have another call at eleven.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: Go ahead.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Thanks, everyone.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Okay, um, is everyone here? I think maybe we can start, Ravi's still, oh, no, he just joined.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: Sorry, sorry. Badge reader at the front was down again.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Again? That's the third time this month.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: Fourth, if you count the garage one.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Okay, so, um, first thing. I heard back from Marisol on the contract. Sort of.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Sort of?

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: She said she has the draft from the vendor and she's, she's going through it. She said, I think, end of next week for a first pass.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: End of next week. Is that a real end of next week or a lawyer end of next week?

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: I, um, I honestly don't know. I'll ask her to be more specific.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: She told me once two weeks and it was five days. So you never know.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Or it was nine days. Depends who you ask.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Fair, fair.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: Did she say anything about the data part? Where the invoices are stored?

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: She mentioned there's a section on that. Um, I didn't, I didn't get the details.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: Okay. I'd like to see it when she's done. If that's allowed.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Yes, of course. I'll forward it to you. All of you, actually.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: And the second demo? Did the vendor give us any dates?

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: They offered two. Um, the Tuesday and the Thursday after next. I think maybe Thursday is better because of the close.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Thursday's fine with me. As long as it's the afternoon, I have the, the thing with the auditors in the morning.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: Which auditors? Tomasz's lot?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Yeah. The prep call.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: Right. I'm in that one too, I think. Wait, no, that's the one Stefan moved.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Stefan moved it to Wednesday. I got the invite, then another one, then I'm not sure which-

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Pavel, it's the second one. The first one got cancelled.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Okay. Good. That's what I figured.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: So Thursday afternoon then, for that. I'll confirm with them. Um, Camila, you sent me your questions, thank you.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Yeah. The scanned ones are at the top. If they're vague on that one I'll keep pushing.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Please do. I think maybe Pavel should also ask about the review screen. The one for, um, wrong amounts.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Sure. I wrote that down already, actually. I want to see what it does with a crooked page.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: And with the regional ones? Like the ones that come in two languages?

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Oh, good point. I didn't think of that. I can ask.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: Okay. If it's easy.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: Hold on, while we're on this. The money. Did Emeka say anything yet?

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: He, um, he looked at the number. He said the finance committee meets the week after the demo, so, we'll bring it there.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: So no answer until then.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Not a formal one, no. But he didn't, he didn't seem against it.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: Okay. That's about as good as it gets with him.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Did he ask how we got to the fifteen extra?

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: He asked. I showed him the, the hours thing from Pavel.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: The sixty hours? Good, I'm glad that was useful. I actually redid it, and it might be closer to, hm, sixty-five if you include the ones people fix twice-

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: Please don't change the number now.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: I'm not changing it, I'm just saying it's maybe-

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: It's fine, Pavel, we can, um, we can look at it after the demo.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Sure. Okay.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: Can I ask something small? About the, the old module. The ERP one.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Yes?

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: Do we tell the rep anything yet? Or is that still waiting?

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Still waiting. I think maybe until Marisol is happy with the paper.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: Okay. I just didn't want to be the one who forgot.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: No, no, it's on my list.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: What's the renewal date on the ERP thing again? I lost the email.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: June, um, the thirtieth, I believe. I'll double check.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Okay, so we have time.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: Plenty of time. Okay, can we do the expense memo? Because I found it.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Oh, good. What did it say?

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: Meals went up. It's sixty a day, not fifty-five.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: See, I said fifty-five and it was close.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: It was five off, Pavel.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Close is close.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Is it per day or per trip? That was the question.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: Per day. Domestic. International has its own table, it's a separate-

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Does it start from the first of March?

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: The first, yeah. Anything before that is the old rate.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: So the conference in February is still the old one.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: Right. Fifty-five. Heh. Pavel was right for that one.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: I'll take it.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Okay. Um, next. The intern. Did she get her login?

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: She did, Thursday, like Tomasz said. But it, it didn't work on the shared drive.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Of course not.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: I sent a ticket. They said Monday.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Maybe someone could, um, put her files somewhere else in the meantime? Just so she's not sitting there.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: I gave her a few reconciliations on a local copy. She's fine.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Good. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: She asked me what the close calendar was and I had to explain the whole, the whole thing with the two versions-

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: You told her about the old one?

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: I told her to only use the one Stefan sent Monday.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: Good. Keep it that way.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Can we go back to the contract for a second? I had one more question.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Yes, go ahead.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Is the term two years or three? Because I vaguely remember something in the quote.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: I think maybe it was, um, one year with the option to, to extend. But I'm not sure. It might have been three.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: That matters. If it's three and the tool is bad, we're stuck.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: Which is what I said about the first one, so I'm glad somebody agrees.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: I don't disagree with you, Ravi, I never did, I just-

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: You played the other side.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: It's my job, apparently.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Okay, okay. Um, I'll check the quote tonight and put it in the thread.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Should I look too? I have the PDF somewhere. I think it's in the folder with the, the screenshots from the demo.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: If you have it, yes, send it to me. Thanks.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Will do. It might be called something like final final.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: Those are never final.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: No, they never are.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: One more thing before we run out of time. The bank rec on Friday. Who's covering?

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: Me again. I don't mind.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: You always say that. I can take half.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: Honestly it's fine. I like the quiet.

utterances.speaker: Ravi
utterances.text: Okay, but if it gets bad, ping me.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Thank you both. Um, anything else? I have to run to a, to another meeting in a minute.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Nothing from me.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: I had a thing about the, the login page again, but-

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Maybe next time, Pavel?

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Next time. Yeah.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Okay. Thanks, everyone.
